title: Preset
description: A saved launch configuration: a serving setup at a version, a model, and the launch options that differ from the engine's defaults (design 0001 §3.4).

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

engine.description: The engine adapter that runs it, such as kvmem-llamacpp; empty for a cloud preset.
engine.title: Serving setup

engine_version.description: The engine's version, such as v0.16.0-rc1; empty for a cloud preset.
engine_version.title: Engine version

endpoint.description: For a cloud preset, in place of an engine: the provider someone else runs that serves its model (config/endpoints/<id>.json), such as openrouter (design 0016 §7).
endpoint.title: Provider

model.description: The model's id in the catalog, such as qwen3.8-27b; for a cloud preset, its id exactly as its provider lists it.
model.title: Model

options.description: The options that differ from the engine's defaults, by their keys (design 0001 §3.1); for a cloud preset: context, max_output, reasoning and images.
options.title: Launch options

host.description: Where it runs; empty: the one host its engine is installed on (decision 0030).
host.title: Host

notes.description: Anything worth knowing: where it came from, what it deviates in.
notes.title: Notes
